$comment: Addresses the Clip fee on a SODAX swap may be paid to (docs/features/sodax-swaps.md). Committed with the code, never set by the environment: a build's CLIP_SODAX_FEE_RECEIVER must be one of these, or it offers no SODAX swaps (fails closed) and a mainnet build is refused. It lists one address, ColdAI LLC's. Change it only in a reviewed commit, and update the pinning test in packages/features/test/sodax-swap.test.ts in the same commit.
